concerns.text: The `contracts/` folder is listed as containing only `material_compound.schema.yaml` and `model_result.schema.yaml`, but the repository also includes `dataset.schema.yaml`, `model_output.schema.yaml`, and `validation_result.schema.yaml`. No plan step references these additional contracts, violating the Plan ↔ contracts consistency rule that every contract must be exercised by at least one plan element.

The data model defines `MaterialCompound`, `DescriptorSet`, and `ModelResult` but does not define an entity that matches the `Dataset` schema (`dataset.schema.yaml`) used for the processed features parquet. This creates a mismatch between the data model and both the plan (which outputs a processed features dataset) and the contract definitions.
